subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose dedicated `/v1/sessions/*` REST management endpoints for HTTP integrations, or should session control remain limited to WebSocket/admin-RPC/plugin surfaces?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding mutating session control to the HTTP API is a public API and security-boundary choice rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
options.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning routes as a narrow Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers with explicit operator-scope and docs coverage.

options.title: Use admin HTTP RPC instead
options.body: Expand or document the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin as the intended HTTP control-plane path and avoid a second dedicated `/v1/sessions/*` API.

options.title: Defer mutating HTTP controls
options.body: Keep HTTP integrations on chat completions plus WebSocket/plugin surfaces until maintainers are ready to own a broader REST control-plane contract.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
recommendation.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning routes as a narrow Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers with explicit operator-scope and docs coverage.
